title: 40th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/40/2024).
From the Speaker's desk: presentation of the proposed Supplementary Budget for 2024, under Article 96 of the Constitution and the Public Finance Act (Law No. 3/2006).
Proceeding with work on the proposed 2024 Supplementary Budget.
Judiciary Committee report on the President's nominees to fill four vacant seats on the Tax Appeal Tribunal.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The late-morning sitting received the government's 2024 supplementary budget and took up a Judiciary Committee report on four Tax Appeal Tribunal appointments.
